summary: Remove the attention CLI alias and retired alert creation mutation.

schema.detail: No database schema or stored identity changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or fleet coordination rule changes.

downtime.detail: No additional daemon startup work or service interruption; timings were not measured.

recovery.detail: No stored-data conversion to undo; roll forward with canonical CLI callers.

compatibility.detail: Use alerts instead of attention and work ask/work update instead of alerts request. POST /v1/attention is removed. Attention READ endpoints, durable IDs, historical claims and modern resolve/withdraw source actions remain.

manual.detail: Migrate CLI callers before upgrading; requires canonical external callers from the dotfiles #9299 prerequisite stack. No data migration is needed.
